description: Agentic OS - the autonomous multi-agent operations layer, converted from the markdown PRD on 2026-09-18 (US-788), which is archived at archive/2026-09-18-agentic-os-markdown/. Agents run as Deno edge functions under functions/ (the serve() tree, deployed through explicit entrypoint lines in supabase/config.toml), invoked by the dispatcher and backed by the agent_* table family with RLS. Tier-1 work runs autonomously; every outward-facing action is drafted through requestApproval/escalate into the approval queue; tier-3 items escalate to the Command Center under /admin/agents. ALL 41 STORIES ARE MARKED passes: true, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF THE CONVERSION. Each one was checked against the artefact it named -- 30 edge functions, 16 tables, 33 shared logic modules and 6 Command Center tabs -- and every one exists. The markdown read as a backlog of work to do while being a record of work already done, which is what made it a shadow backlog rather than a plan. The mapping is in each story notes field; see prd-agentic-os.json history and src/lib/agenticOsPrd.test.ts, which re-checks the artefacts on every run so a deletion cannot leave a story quietly claiming to pass. New agentic OS work goes here rather than in the markdown. The prd-verify workflow already globs prd-*.json, so this file is picked up with no workflow change.
